name: Straight kurta
note: Design parameters in mm, measured from landmarks (halfway.md, the Amber model). The default is the photographed garment: neck depth from the neckline view (neck-point line to the centre-front edge, 130.4 px x 0.3046 mm, after the StepA step 3 snap; was 40.9 mm), width = the agreed neck-l -> neck-r distance. Each view maps a CHANGE in mm to its own px (its mmPerPx and landmarks); the range must stay inside each plate's reach (plate.json neck.reachDeepMm, reachWideMm per side).

rules: lace width < neck depth (12 mm lace, 20 mm minimum depth)
corners stay on the shoulder line
